verdicts.reason: A packs the image strip and the '& Baby Toddler BEDDING' lockup into the top third. Its dot grids float in the middle, and the bottom ~45% of the canvas is empty, so the layout is badly top-heavy. B is the less bad one: it centres the lockup vertically and anchors the dot grids in the bottom corners, which balances the frame better. B still has large dead bands above and below the headline, and in both the image strip is a small, cropped sliver with the dot pattern sitting on top of it.
